Vt.bar_b_note: A warm, appealing stylised elder whose face, eyes and costume palette would sit beside Palworld's humans; only the noisy felt-like hair and flat grey-stage light hold the finish back.

Eo.bar_b_note: The blue-grey panel tone is right, but small orange-on-teal text, no controller-styled primary action and no gold progression read as a debug panel rather than a shipping game's crafting UI.

Lf.bar_b_note: Same as Vt: the character's appeal, readable face and natural palette carry it; the hair texture noise and neutral flat lighting are the only finish gaps.

Kg.bar_b_note: Flat magenta ground rings as telegraphs, an unreadable player creature, a muddy brown low-value forest with no purple storm sky, and a HUD covering much of the frame (plus camera-in-foliage frames on B) sink it against Palworld's boss-fight shot.

Bs.bar_b_note: Standing and hit-react are near the owner's Tanglevolt bar, but the broken faint poses (A floating, B nose-down) and B's over-bright blue veins stop it reading as shipped quality.

Gc.bar_b_note: A clear, likeable smith silhouette with on-palette costume, but flat shading, soft low-detail textures and small hard-to-read eyes fall short of Palworld's character finish.

top_changes.change: Stormwood fight (Kg): replace the flat magenta telegraph rings/slabs with real-object tells and impacts (lightning, stones, dust), add camera collision/foliage fade so trunks and canopy never fill the frame, rim-light and value-separate both fighters (especially the player's creature), bring in the purple storm sky and moss/copper accents, and slim the HUD side panel and bottom bar.

Tanglevolt (Bs): rebuild the faint-mid/faint-end animation so the body collapses grounded onto its shadow with legs attached (no floating slab, no nose-down handstand), and keep side A's restrained violet vein emission rather than side B's saturated blue.

Craft panel (Eo): keep side A's large type, wrap ingredient lines instead of truncating, show more recipes per screen, make Craft a teal controller-glyph primary button and Leave a clear secondary prompt, and use gold for have/need progression.
